67752-on-building-a-theatre-stage-constr.title: And Community Buildings
67752-on-building-a-theatre-stage-constr.creator: Irving Pichel
67752-on-building-a-theatre-stage-constr.description: A book by Irving Pichel. auditorium and platform than that of the theatre. Churches, lecture halls, and the chambers of legislative assemblies are planned with the same general end of making a person or persons at one part of the room audible and visible to many persons gathered in another part.

arxiv-1610-04758.title: Sensing Emotions in Text Messages: An Application and Deployment Study of EmotionPush
arxiv-1610-04758.creator: Shih-Ming Wang Chun-Hui Li Yu-Chun Lo, Ting-Hao (Kenneth) Huang Lun-Wei Ku
arxiv-1610-04758.description: Abstract Instant messaging and push notifications play important roles in modern digital life. To enable robust sense-making and rich context awareness in computer mediated communications, we introduce EmotionPush , a system that automatically conveys the emotion of received text with a colored push notification on mobile devices.

arxiv-2008-13185.title: Retarded resonance Casimir-Polder interaction of a uniformly rotating two-atom system
arxiv-2008-13185.creator: Saptarshi Saha, Chiranjeeb Singha, Arpan Chatterjee
arxiv-2008-13185.description: Abstract We consider here, a two-atom system is uniformly moving through a circular ring at an ultra-relativistic speed and weakly interacting with common external fields. The vacuum fluctuations of the quantum fields generate the entanglement between the atoms. Hence an effective energy shift is originated, which depends on the inter-atomic distance. This is commonly known as resonance Casimir-Polder interaction (RCPI).

arxiv-2204-02152.title: UTMOS: UTokyo-SaruLab System for VoiceMOS Challenge 2022 Thanks: * Equal contribution.
arxiv-2204-02152.creator: Takaaki Saeki *, Detai Xin *, Wataru Nakata *
arxiv-2204-02152.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Takaaki Saeki *, Detai Xin *, Wataru Nakata *. We present the UTokyo-SaruLab mean opinion score (MOS) prediction system submitted to VoiceMOS Challenge 2022. The challenge is to predict the MOS values of speech samples collected from previous Blizzard Challenges and Voice Conversion Challenges for two tracks: a main track for in-domain prediction and an out-of-domain (OOD) track for which there is less labeled data from different listening tests. Our system is based on ensemble learning of strong and weak learners.

arxiv-2207-11322.title: Greedy Allocations and Equitable Matchings Thanks: I am grateful to Yeon-Koo Che, Federico Echenique, Chris Shannon, and numerous others for discussion and feedback. My thanks also to seminar participants at UNC, NYU, Rochester, UCLA, and U Chicago for helpful comments and conversations.
arxiv-2207-11322.creator: Quitzé Valenzuela-Stookey
arxiv-2207-11322.description: Abstract I provide a novel approach to characterizing the set of interim realizable allocations, in the spirit of Matthews 1984 and Border 1991 . The approach allows me to identify precisely why exact characterizations are difficult to obtain in some settings.

arxiv-2312-13150.title: Splatter Image: Ultra-Fast Single-View 3D Reconstruction
arxiv-2312-13150.creator: Stanislaw Szymanowicz, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi
arxiv-2312-13150.description: Abstract We introduce the Splatter Image, an ultra-efficient approach for monocular 3D object reconstruction. Splatter Image is based on Gaussian Splatting, which allows fast and high-quality reconstruction of 3D scenes from multiple images. We apply Gaussian Splatting to monocular reconstruction by learning a neural network that, at test time, performs reconstruction in a feed-forward manner, at 38 FPS.

arxiv-2403-03187.title: Reliable, Adaptable, and Attributable Language Models with Retrieval
arxiv-2403-03187.creator: Akari Asai, Zexuan Zhong, Danqi Chen, Pang Wei Koh, Luke Zettlemoyer, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Wen-tau Yih
arxiv-2403-03187.description: Abstract Parametric language models (LMs), which are trained on vast amounts of web data, exhibit remarkable flexibility and capability. However, they still face practical challenges such as hallucinations, difficulty in adapting to new data distributions, and a lack of verifiability. In this position paper, we advocate for retrieval-augmented LMs to replace parametric LMs as the next generation of LMs.

arxiv-2404-09779.title: A replica analysis of under-bagging
arxiv-2404-09779.creator: Takashi Takahashi
arxiv-2404-09779.description: Abstract Under-bagging (UB), which combines under-sampling and bagging, is a popular ensemble learning method for training classifiers on an imbalanced data. Using bagging to reduce the increased variance caused by the reduction in sample size due to under-sampling is a natural approach.

arxiv-2501-04592.title: Motion and hydrodynamic resistance of an elastic bead confined in a square microchannel
arxiv-2501-04592.creator: Charles Paul Moore, Hiba Belkadi, Brouna Safi, Gabriel Amselem, Charles N. Baroud
arxiv-2501-04592.description: Abstract Cells and other soft particles are often forced to flow in confined geometries in both laboratory and natural environments, where the elastic deformation induces an additional drag and pressure drop across the particle. In contrast with other multiphase flows, the physical parameters that determine this additional pressure are still not known.

arxiv-2502-03550.title: TD-M(PC) 2 : Improving Temporal Difference MPC Through Policy Constraint
arxiv-2502-03550.description: Abstract Model-based reinforcement learning algorithms that combine model-based planning and learned value/policy prior have gained significant recognition for their high data efficiency and superior performance in continuous control. However, we discover that existing methods that rely on standard SAC-style policy iteration for value learning, directly using data generated by the planner, often result in persistent value overestimation .

arxiv-2502-08559.title: Separable Approximations of Optimal Value Functions and Their Representation by Neural Networks Thanks: This research was supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) - project number 463912816.
arxiv-2502-08559.creator: Mario Sperl, Luca Saluzzi, Dante Kalise, Lars Grüne
arxiv-2502-08559.description: Abstract The use of separable approximations is proposed to mitigate the curse of dimensionality related to the approximation of high-dimensional value functions in optimal control. The separable approximation exploits intrinsic decaying sensitivity properties of the system, where the influence of a state variable on another diminishes as their spatial, temporal, or graph-based distance grows.

arxiv-2504-02601.title: The homotopy category of strongly flat modules
arxiv-2504-02601.creator: Javad Asadollahi and Somayeh Sadeghi
arxiv-2504-02601.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Javad Asadollahi and Somayeh Sadeghi. In this paper, we plan to build upon significant results by Amnon Neeman regarding the homotopy category of flat modules to study 𝕂 ⁡ ( S ​ SF ​ - ​ R ) {\mathbb{K}}({S\rm{SF}}\mbox{-}R) , the homotopy category of S S -strongly flat modules, where S S is a multiplicatively closed subset of a commutative ring R R .

arxiv-2511-14349.title: ARC-Chapter: Structuring Hour-Long Videos into Navigable Chapters and Hierarchical Summaries
arxiv-2511-14349.creator: Junfu Pu, Teng Wang, Yixiao Ge, Yuying Ge, Chen Li, Ying Shan
arxiv-2511-14349.description: Abstract The proliferation of hour-long videos ( e.g ., lectures, podcasts, documentaries) has intensified demand for efficient content structuring. However, existing approaches are constrained by small-scale training with annotations that are typical short and coarse, restricting generalization to nuanced transitions in long videos.

pmc-10613752.creator: Sugihiro Hamaguchi, Sei Takahashi, Yuji Endo, Yohei Nakamoto, Tetsuro Aita, Toru Naganuma, Hiroaki Nakagawa, Toshihiko Takada
pmc-10613752.description: Introduction: Intravenous antibiotics are the primary treatment of choice for pyogenic vertebral osteomyelitis (PVO). Surgical intervention is required when the initial antibiotic treatment fails but is often difficult to perform, especially in older adults with multiple comorbidities, because of the reduced physical activity.

pmc-10631110.title: Pertrochanteric hip fracture is associated with mobility decline and poorer physical performance 4 to 6 months post-hip fracture
pmc-10631110.creator: Minna A Kujala, Markus T Hongisto, Tiina Luukkaala, Sari Stenholm, Maria S Nuotio
pmc-10631110.description: BackgroundTo study the effect of hip fracture type on physical performance, functional ability and change in mobility four to six months after the injury.MethodsA total of 1331 patients out of consecutive 2052 patients aged ≥ 65 years who underwent hip fracture surgery were included in the study.

pmc-10632586.title: A multi-layered computational structural genomics approach enhances domain-specific interpretation of Kleefstra syndrome variants in EHMT1
pmc-10632586.creator: Young-In Chi, Salomão D Jorge, Davin R Jensen, Brian C Smith, Brian F Volkman, Angela J Mathison, Gwen Lomberk, Michael T Zimmermann, Raul Urrutia
pmc-10632586.description: This study investigates the functional significance of assorted variants of uncertain significance (VUS) in euchromatic histone lysine methyltransferase 1 (EHMT1), which is critical for early development and normal physiology. EHMT1 mutations cause Kleefstra syndrome and are linked to various human cancers. However, accurate functional interpretations of these variants are yet to be made, limiting diagnoses and future research.

pmc-10741451.title: Integration of Glutamate Dehydrogenase and Nanoporous Gold for Electrochemical Detection of Glutamate
pmc-10741451.creator: Ting Cai, Keshuai Shang, Xiaolei Wang, Xiaoyan Qi, Ruijun Liu, Xia Wang
pmc-10741451.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Glutamate, a non-essential amino acid produced by fermentation, plays a significant role in disease diagnosis and food safety. It is important to enable the real-time monitoring of glutamate concentration for human health and nutrition.

pmc-11532872.title: Evaluating crop nitrogen status in maize leaves: A predictive modelling approach using chlorophyll fluorescence parameters
pmc-11532872.creator: Xiangzeng Meng, Shan Zhang, Lichun Wang, Yang Yu, Sijia Duan, Yixiang Zhang, Yanjie Lv, Yongjun Wang
pmc-11532872.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The consumption of chemical fertilizers has increased eight-fold since the 19th century, outstripping crop yields increases and, emphasizing the need for precise nitrogen (N) assessment in crops to optimize fertilization and mitigate environmental impacts. This study developed a model using chlorophyll fluorescence technology to accurately evaluate the N status in maize leaves while addressing the limitations of current labor-intensive and environmentally sensitive methods.

pmc-12625236.title: Decitabine-mediated DNA methylation dynamics at pericentromeric satellite 2 repeats
pmc-12625236.creator: Enrica Sordini, Eugenia Ciurlia, Alessia Zanella, Benedetta Fogliardi, Dorela Lame, Antonella Poloni, Stefano Amatori, Mirco Fanelli
pmc-12625236.description: The hypomethylating agents (HMAs) 5-azacytidine (vidaza-AZA) and 5-aza-2′-deoxycytidine (decitabine-DAC) are part of the standard of care for the treatment of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML). However, the molecular events mediated by HMAs in MDS and AML are poorly understood, and the efficacy of MDS and AML treatments is still improvable.

pmc-12975166.creator: Fangpeng Ling, Xuemei Chen, Binling Fan, Shiyu Lan, Chao Jin, Cailian Cai, Keshan Wang, Hongyu Liu, Jianning Jiang, Minghua Su
pmc-12975166.description: Rationale:Doxycycline is a broad-spectrum antibiotic widely used in clinical practice. The most common adverse reactions are gastrointestinal disturbances, whereas thrombocytopenia caused by doxycycline is rarely reported.Patient concerns:Two patients developed severe thrombocytopenia shortly after initiating doxycycline therapy, with platelet counts decreasing post-administration precipitously.

pmc-13229853.title: Ethical review key considerations for organoid applications in biomedical research—a systematic review
pmc-13229853.creator: Guo Zhili, Zhang Nenghua
pmc-13229853.description: The organoid co-culture model, a novel tool for reconstructing three-dimensional microenvironments to study cell-cell interactions, has demonstrated significant potential in biomedical research in recent years. It holds considerable value for elucidating tumor immunosuppression mechanisms, conducting drug sensitivity tests, studying immune responses in infectious diseases, and revealing pathological features of neurodegenerative diseases.
